content.text: $reviewing check `.writing/draft.md` against `.writing/task.md` and the active goals, correct existing prose, and report

payload.name: exec
payload.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,240p' /workspace/.agents/skills/reviewing/SKILL.md && echo '---TASK---' && sed -n '1,240p' .writing/task.md && echo '---GOALS---' && sed -n '1,260p' .writing/goals.md && echo '---DRAFT---' && sed -n '1,320p' .writing/draft.md",workdir:"/workspace",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:20000});
text(r.output);
